clue.text: Subject of a very loud song

parts.note: ff, fortissimo, is the musical marking for very loud
an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: Someone asks what a very loud song is about.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a subject or matter of concern, as in 'that is my business, my concern'.

clue.text: Ability of the French to hide in tree

indicators.note: something hiding in a tree sits within its letters, so one word goes inside the other

parts.note: a fir is a conifer
la is French for 'the' (feminine)

explanation.surface: A French talent for hiding up a tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a natural talent or knack for something.

clue.text: Crime of the Century carried out from Nevadan city

indicators.note: something carried out of a place is removed from it, so a letter is taken away

parts.note: Carson City is the state capital of Nevada
C is the standard abbreviation for century (Roman numeral 100)

explanation.surface: A tabloid 'crime of the century' committed in a Nevada city.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: deliberately setting fire to property is a criminal offence.

clue.text: Dramatic artists about to replace American ministers

indicators.note: one piece takes the place of another inside the word for performers

parts.note: actors are dramatic artists
re is Latin-derived 'concerning, about'

explanation.surface: Actors standing in for American clergymen.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: in the Church of England a parish priest or minister holds this title.

clue.text: Having feminine features, desire to enter Middle Eastern country? On the contrary

indicators.note: one word entering another goes inside it
reverses the roles: the country goes into the desire, not the desire into the country

parts.note: a wish is a desire
Oman is on the Arabian Peninsula

explanation.surface: Someone with a feminine look longs to visit a Middle Eastern country, or the reverse.
explanation.walkthrough: Taken at face value the desire would go into the country; 'On the contrary' swaps the roles of 'to enter', so the country goes inside the desire.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: describes a man or thing with qualities thought typical of women.

clue.text: Towards which place is extremely tentative whore travelling?

indicators.note: letters that travel move about into a new order
the extremes of a word are its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A hesitant prostitute on the move wonders where to go.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' gives TE from tentative; add WHORE and 'travelling' rearranges the seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic adverb meaning 'to what place' or 'whither'.

clue.text: Train Sam Allardyce to box

indicators.note: the name boxes in, or encloses, the letters wanted

explanation.surface: An instruction to coach football manager Sam Allardyce in boxing.
explanation.walkthrough: Sam Allardyce is an English football manager; 'Train' looks like a verb but names a locomotive.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Mallard is the steam locomotive holding the world speed record for steam, a famous British train.

clue.text: 1 in 21 possibly wearing no pants

definitions.note: 1 is read as 'one', and 21 is the city clued at 21 across, so a person from there

indicators.note: pants as a verb is avoided; here it is British slang for rubbish or poor, signalling a scrambling

explanation.surface: A cross-reference picture of someone in a cold capital going without trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: In British slang 'pants' means rubbish, so 'wearing no pants' is a messed-up WEARING NO. The definition reads '1' as 'one', a person in the capital at 21.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a person found in the Norwegian capital would likely be a native of that country.

clue.text: Veronica Spooner's charming treatment of unwanted visitor?

indicators.note: Spooner swapped the opening sounds of words, so the starts of two words trade places

parts.note: a weed is an unwanted plant that turns up in a garden
a spell is what a charmer casts

explanation.surface: Someone named Veronica asks how Spooner would charm away an unwanted guest.
explanation.walkthrough: Swapping the starts of WEED and SPELL gives SPEED WELL; Veronica is the botanical genus name.
explanation.definitionFit: Botanical: Veronica is the Latin genus of the small blue-flowered plants of this name.

clue.text: Butcher is writing out MA in full

parts.note: in physics, m is the symbol for mass
a is the abbreviation for acre

explanation.surface: A meat-cutter writes out his MA qualification in full.
explanation.walkthrough: MA looks like Master of Arts, but its two letters are expanded separately: M as mass and A as acre.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym as a verb: to slaughter brutally or in large numbers.

clue.text: Relatively big day for German store

indicators.note: one letter stands in for another, swapping it out

parts.note: larger is the comparative, big relative to something else

explanation.surface: A notably big day for a German shop.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a room or cupboard where food is kept.

clue.text: Old woman meets Lance Armstrong, perhaps — a spectacle where nothing is spoken

parts.note: gran is short for grandmother, an old woman
the cyclist was stripped of his titles for doping, an example of a drug cheat

explanation.surface: A grandmother meets the disgraced cyclist at a silent show.
explanation.definitionFit: Genre: in this form of opera every line is sung, with no spoken dialogue, unlike operetta.

clue.text: Black out from decompression sickness, which can result in deaths

indicators.note: a letter taken out of a word is removed

parts.note: the bends is the divers' name for decompression sickness
B is the abbreviation for black (as on pencils)

explanation.surface: A diver passes out from the bends, which can kill.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an end can mean a death, as in 'came to a sticky end'.

clue.text: Coffee tables press on trousers

indicators.note: used as a verb, to pocket, so the words pocket the letters wanted

explanation.surface: Coffee-house furniture and pressing your trousers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'trousers' looks like clothing but is a verb meaning pockets.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a strong black coffee made by forcing steam through ground beans.

clue.text: Ordered hash pipes to be ordered

indicators.note: the letters are to be put in order, rearranged

explanation.surface: Tidy hash pipes needing to be ordered from a dealer.
explanation.definitionFit: Idiom: neat and in good order, like a well-kept ship.

clue.text: Reason to limit booze

parts.note: to ration is to limit a supply
ale is beer, a kind of booze

explanation.surface: A grounds for cutting back on drinking.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the underlying reasoning or justification for something.

clue.text: Balls' motivation to get close to final

parts.note: drive is ambition, motivation

indicators.note: the close of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A footballer's drive to reach the final.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: both are slang words for nonsense or rubbish talk.

clue.text: German male — one trying to lose weight

definitions.meaning: a common German man's first name

explanation.definitionFit: Homograph: a German forename and also the noun for a person on a slimming regime.

clue.text: Cancel lessons on religion, science, and …? Not art, initially

parts.note: RE is Religious Education, the school subject
'n' is a casual short form of and, as in rock 'n' roll
the school subject Art and Design without the art leaves design, whose first letter is wanted

explanation.surface: A list of school subjects being dropped, trailing off before art.
explanation.walkthrough: The '…?' asks what follows 'and': in the UK school subject Art and Design, dropping art leaves Design, giving D.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to revoke or annul a law, order or agreement.

clue.text: Subdue student overwhelmed by rum

indicators.note: one piece is engulfed by the other, inside it

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd, strange
L is a learner driver's plate, so a student

explanation.surface: Restraining a student who has drunk too much rum.
explanation.definitionFit: Loose synonym: to choke someone and so overpower or suppress them.

clue.text: One who has an attempt at goal that rolls along the ground

definitions.text: One who has an attempt at goal
definitions.meaning: a player who shoots at goal
in cricket, a ball that skids low along the pitch instead of bouncing

explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: a player who shoots, and a cricket delivery that keeps very low after pitching.

clue.text: Italian church court

parts.note: a Roman is an Italian, from Rome
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: An Italian church court, as in an ecclesiastical tribunal.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym as a verb: to woo someone or pursue them amorously.

clue.text: Capital often frozen due to unlimited industrial action

indicators.note: without its limits, the first and last letters

parts.note: a go-slow is a form of industrial action in which workers deliberately slow down

explanation.surface: A city frozen solid because of an all-out strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Norwegian capital is often icy and snowbound in winter.

clue.text: Like an action replay of constipation?

definitions.text: Like an action replay of constipation?

parts.words: Like an action replay of constipation?
parts.note: television replays are shown in retarded speed; constipated bowels also move sluggishly

explanation.definitionFit: Pun: the term for a slowed-down replay also describes a sluggish bowel movement.

clue.text: Head of Theology enthralled by article on Paul's Second Letter to the Corinthians

indicators.note: held captive by, so placed inside

parts.note: the is the definite article

indicators.note: the second letter of the name
the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A theologian absorbed in Paul's Second Epistle to the Corinthians.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Paul's Second Letter to the Corinthians' looks like the epistle; 'Second' just picks A from Paul, and the definition is a letter of the Greek alphabet the Corinthians used.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Corinthians wrote in Greek, and this is the eighth letter of that alphabet.

clue.text: Live in very large house, at last — very large

indicators.note: one piece sits in another

parts.note: OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize
to be is to exist, live

indicators.note: the last letter of the word

explanation.surface: Living in a huge house, a person ends up huge.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: extremely fat, very overweight.

clue.text: Cured meat made from antelope's rejected but quietly rejected

indicators.note: sent back, so read backwards
turned away, so taken out of the word

parts.note: read as the plural antelopes; impalas are African antelopes
p is piano, the musical marking for quietly

explanation.surface: A cured sausage made from rejected antelope meat.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a spicy Italian sausage of cured pork, eaten cold.

clue.text: Offered to look after English communist

parts.note: to tend is to look after
red is a common nickname for a communist

explanation.surface: A volunteer offering to care for an English communist.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to put forward formally, as a resignation or payment.

clue.text: Champion desperately needed form regularly

indicators.note: frantic, wildly, so the letters are thrown into disorder
taking every other letter

explanation.surface: A sports champion badly needs good form.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regularly' picks F and R from form; 'desperately' rearranges them with NEEDED.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: one who champions a cause defends it.

clue.text: Times journalist removed

parts.note: eras are periods of time
ed is short for editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A Times journalist has been removed from the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' looks like the newspaper but means ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: wiped out or deleted.
